The savage blades are strong enough to cut down any foe, no matter how strong.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 58 |durability = 41 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Savage Lynel Sword}} Savage Lynel Swords are used by [[White-Maned Lynel]]s, [[Silver Lynel]]s, and [[Golden Lynel]]s. As it takes time for [[Lynel]]s to scale up, Savage Lynel Swords may not be available until later in the game. However, the White-Maned Lynel in the [[Second Gatehouse]] of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] does not scale, meaning it will always carry a Savage Lynel Sword. They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s that are created and utilized by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} The blades of this Sword are said to be strong enough to cut down any foe. Since they are made of metal, Savage Lynel Swords will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
